P.name: Concussive Blows
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Braum's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Winter's Bite|Braum}}'' each apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Concussive Blows'' to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times. Once the first stack has been applied, any allied {{tip|champion|champion's}} basic attack applies an additional stack to the target {{tip|on-hit}}.
P.description2: The fourth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|{{pplevel|26 to 196|type=his level|label1=level}}|magic damage}} {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} them for {{pp|changedisplay=true|1.25 to 1.75 for 3|1 to 13|type=his level|label1=level}} seconds.
P.description3: This effect cannot apply to the same target more than once every few seconds. During this immunity period, affected targets take{{ft|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to 40% of the trigger damage|{{as|{{pplevel|26*0.4 to 196*0.4}} '''bonus''' magic damage}}}}from '''Braum's''' basic attacks.

Q.name: Winter's Bite
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' propels ice from his shield in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 70% decaying over 2 seconds.

W.name: Stand Behind Me
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' {{tip|dashes}} to put himself {{tt|between|150 units from his ally towards the closest enemy}} the target ally and the closest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tt|within 1500 units|from the ally's location}}, and upon arrival grants himself and the ally {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for 3 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Ally Bonus Armor|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Ally Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
W.description2: ''Stand Behind Me'' can be [[Self-targeted|self cast]] to instantly grant '''Braum''' the '''bonus''' resistances.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Self Bonus Armor|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 36% '''bonus''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Self Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 36% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
W.description3: ''{{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Unbreakable
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' sets his shield in the target direction for a duration, creating a barrier in front of him that intercepts all incoming hostile {{tip|projectiles}} and reduces the damage '''Braum''' takes through it from enemies in the target direction. The first instance of damage dealt by a {{tip|champion}} from this direction is reduced by 100%. ''Unbreakable'' does not affect {{tip|turret|turrets}}.
E.description2: While his shield is raised, '''Braum''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting}}.

R.name: Glacial Fissure
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Braum''' leaps into the air and slams his shield into the ground, creating a fissure from the impact that travels forth in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within its path as well as those around '''Braum'''.
R.description2: The first target hit is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for at least {{fd|0.6}} seconds, increased if they are further away from '''Braum'''. All other enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
R.description3: A field of ice is created along the fissure's path, lasting for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. The field disappears after the duration ends in the same order and speed it was created with.
